t: The Drayton RT212 thermostatic radiator valve and lockshield set provides reliable and precise temperature control for heating systems. The bi-directional valve body design accommodates vertical or horizontal flow and return mounting, offering installation flexibility for plumbers and heating engineers. Featuring a fast-acting liquid sensor, it ensures efficient heating management with a temperature range of 12 to 29°C and a frost protection setting to prevent pipe damage. Its traditional style with a white and chrome finish makes it suitable for various interior designs.
